title: Manifest tick-index column is never validated — mislabeled index lines in surge.t1 pass the T1 gate silently (comparison is positional)
detail: read_manifest ignores fields[0] (the tick index) entirely; hashes append in file order and compare positionally. Duplicated/renumbered index labels with intact hash order and count pass the gate; label corruption is invisible.
recommended_fix: Validate fields[0] parses as the expected index (position+1) when appending hash lines; fail loudly on mismatch so the blessed self-description cannot lie.

title: Manifest `demo` header is parsed but never checked against the golden being verified — a mislabeled demo line passes silently
detail: check_manifest validates version, seed, catalog_hash, logic_hz, ticks, and hashes but never m.demo against demo_name. The surge.t1 `demo surge` header line can drift or mislabel with zero detection.
recommended_fix: Add `if m.demo != demo_name` to check_manifest (and run_replay) so a manifest whose demo header disagrees with its filename fails loudly.
